folderGrammar.contentFolderRule: SHULL-CHG-0024 (2026-09-16), superseding SHULL-CHG-0023's folderGrammar (2026-09-16), which itself superseded the SHULL-CHG-0005-locked five-per-section structure. 'Guided Notes', 'Presentations', and 'Quiz' are created once per Unit, as siblings of that unit's Section folders — not duplicated into each section, because a guided-notes packet, slide deck, or a unit's quiz bank/tests span a whole unit, not one section. 'Quiz' is the renamed, unit-level successor to the old Section-level 'Tests-Quizizz' (same contents: quizzes, unit tests, exit tickets, bell ringers, A-D versions, keys). 'Labs-Case Studies-Projects' remains the only per-Section content folder, same spelling, every time. There is no 'Homework' folder at any level: homework files (practice sets, worksheets, take-home work, keys) are filed as loose files directly inside the Section folder itself. Reuse existing folders case-insensitively at both levels. Never create 'Tests' or 'Tests-Quizizz' beside 'Quiz'. Unit and Section subfolders are created on demand.
folderGrammar.homeworkFiling: No Homework folder exists at any level as of SHULL-CHG-0024. Homework files are loose files directly inside 'Section ##.# - Section Name/', not inside any subfolder.

operations.search: search_files with parentId = '<ID>' is the reliable folder-verification query
operations.saveMarkdown: disableConversionToGoogleType: true AND contentMimeType: text/plain, or Drive converts it to a Google Doc
operations.move: SUPPORTED. update_file accepts parentId and replaces the existing parent - a true reparent that PRESERVES the file ID, so links survive and rollback is exact. Verified from the tool contract 2026-09-08 (test T-3). Do NOT use copy_file + trash_file to move: that creates a new ID and breaks every existing link.
operations.delete: trash_file only. There is no permanent-delete tool. Emptying the trash is the user's action.
